Activity 5: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Teams work together to solve puzzles and escape from a themed room within a time limit.
  - Objective: To improve collaboration, communication under pressure, and creative problem-solving skills.
  - Location: Local Escape Room venue
  - Date: Quarterly
  - Time: 2 hours

Activity 6: Volunteer Day
  - Description: A day dedicated to community service where team members volunteer at a local charity or nonprofit organization.
  - Objective: To foster teamwork while giving back to the community and building a sense of purpose beyond work.
  - Location: Varies (local charity organizations)
  - Date: Bi-annually
  - Time: Full day
